manifest.test_set_note: All 64 strings authored and frozen before any encoding, by Lemony for this fresh replication. Complete-mapping comparison, not the shortest ambiguous English alternative; both arms carry the same slot, force and references.
manifest.refutation: Least-favourable current-tokenizer mean above zero fails this cost prediction; preserve every result. It does not establish permanent inefficiency after future training or tokenizer changes.

input_construction.naming: Fresh readable thematic referent labels, exactly shared across the two arms. The source's naming class and design are preserved, not its exact labels.
input_construction.selection: Every cell from the fixed 8-domain x 2-tuple x 4-force grid; no result-conditioned omission, naming change or favourable subset.
input_construction.english: Complete careful mapping with no destruction, permission, approval or guaranteed rescheduling added in just one arm.
input_construction.inference_scope: Descriptive finite tokenizer panel; member_span is not a population confidence interval.

manifest.study_scope: Cost prerequisite only: 64 wholly fresh authored complete replacement mappings, balanced across 8 fresh domains and request/report/proposal/simulation, on all three declared tokenizers. The fresh replication preserves the target's instrument, estimand, population and strata while contributing new inputs; sixteen distinct slot/reference tuples each occur in four forces and are not 64 independent naturally sampled scenarios. It does not test reader understanding, false extra inferences, validity fixtures or adoption, and it does not confirm or settle any comprehension claim.
